name: Tom Kean Jr.
stance: Introduced the House companion to the AI Emergency Button Act requiring a human shutdown capability in advanced AI, backs stronger AI chip export-control enforcement, and supports a unified national AI policy framework.

statements.text: Sent letters to the CEOs of major U.S. AI companies citing security lapses that threaten advanced AI technology, calling for congressional oversight and asking how they are meeting their voluntary White House commitments.
statements.outlet: Office of Rep. Tom Kean Jr.

statements.text: Introduced the Stop Stealing Our Chips Act with Rep. Julie Johnson to strengthen enforcement of U.S. export controls against illegal acquisition of American AI chips by China.
The United States needs a unified AI policy. And we need it now. I am encouraged to see @POTUS take this critical step forward with a responsible AI framework.

It is critical that the U.S. remains at the forefront of AI development and that our technology is protected by robust export controls. That is why I introduced the Stop Stealing Our Chips Act to create a whistleblower incentive program at the Bureau of Industry and Security.
Introduced the House companion to Sen. Kennedy's AI Emergency Button Act, which would require advanced AI systems to include a technical capability for a human operator to shut the system down.
While AI can be a helpful tool, it is essential that humans remain in control of complex artificial intelligence systems.
